text:
lee: Hi folks, I accepted the org invite but I only see one repo (public-docs). I expected redwood-go and infra-scripts. Also GitHub UI shows 'Authorize SSO' when I click the org. I already enabled 2FA yesterday. Who should I ping for team access?

carmen: Welcome Lee! Quick troubleshooting: did the invite go to the same GitHub account you signed in with? Try the SSO link (https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso) and authorize. If it errors, tell us the exact message.

lee: It redirects to our SSO and then shows 'link_failed: no_matching_account'. My GitHub account is lee-personal and the invite was to lee@redwood.com — I think I signed in with the wrong username earlier.

tyrell: Hey Lee, I can fix that. We normally send invites to your work account. Can you confirm your GitHub username for the work account?

lee: work username is lee-rw. Thanks.

idp-bot: Reminder: Finish SSO authorization to get org-scoped repo access. See internal docs: https://redwood.internal/security/sso-github (internal).

tyrell: I canceled the old invite and resent to lee-rw. Accept it while signed into lee-rw and then authorize SSO. After that I'll add you to eng-go which grants redwood-go and infra-scripts access.

lee: Accepted and authorized SSO. I can see the org now but infra-scripts still not in my repo list.

carmen: That likely means you're not in the team yet. Tyrell, can you add Lee to eng-go and eng-infra?

tyrell: Added lee-rw to eng-go (write on redwood-go) and eng-infra (read on infra-scripts). If you need push on infra-scripts, say so and I'll bump it.

lee: I can view both repos now. Tried to push a quick branch to redwood-go and got 'permission denied (publickey)'. I added my SSH key in settings but maybe it's not picked up.

carmen: Run `ssh -T git@github.com` to confirm which username the key is associated with. If it shows your personal account, add the key to the work account or use HTTPS + PAT for pushes.

lee: `ssh -T` prints 'Hi lee-rw! You've successfully authenticated'. Reattempting push worked after I re-added the key to the work account. All good now, thanks! :tada:

tyrell: Great — closing this one. If you need CI or Actions permissions, open a ticket with repo name and access level and we'll review.

lee: Will do. Appreciate the quick help everyone :)
